cap.name: Cap
cap.description: Self-hosted proof-of-work verification using your own Cap server.
cap.keyHint: Use the site key and secret from your Cap dashboard, not the dashboard ADMIN_KEY. Challenge difficulty is configured on your Cap server.

placeholders.siteKey: Public key rendered in the browser

hints.capServer: Enter the server base URL, including any path prefix, without the site key or /siteverify. Visitors must be able to reach it; HTTPS pages need an HTTPS endpoint. The optional verification URL is for server-side access only (for example, a Docker hostname). Widget assets are served by this site. Allow this site’s origin in Cap CORS settings.
hints.threshold: This channel runs invisibly and returns a score between 0 and 1; requests below the threshold are rejected.
hints.endpoint: google.com is unreachable from mainland China, so Google mirrors reCAPTCHA on recaptcha.net; both accept the same key pair. Automatic probes the global domain per visitor and falls back to the mirror, and the server verifies against whichever domain answers.
hints.keysMissing: A channel only goes live once both the site key and the secret are filled in.
hints.fallback: When a visitor's browser cannot load the main channel's script — a blocked domain, a dead key, a blocking extension — the sign-in page switches to the backup channel without a reload, and the server accepts tokens from either one. The backup needs its own key pair from its own console; leaving it empty counts as unconfigured.
hints.scopes: Verification only applies to username and password forms. Social sign-in is unaffected.
hints.advanced: More threads solve the challenge faster but drain and heat a phone; Automatic uses every core the browser reports. The timeout covers fetching a challenge, redeeming it and the server-side check, so raise it for a slow self-hosted server. Haptic feedback vibrates briefly on tap. The troubleshooting link only appears once a browser blocks the widget; left empty it points at Cap's own page, which some networks cannot reach.
